Job Title: Senior Technical Test Engineer - Sr. Analyst - ACS SONG

Management Level: Level 10 - Sr. Analyst

Location: Kochi 

Must Have Skills: Web automation (Playwright/JavaScript), API automation (Playwright/Karate - JavaScript) 

Good to have skills: AI-assisted testing tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)

Experience: 3-5 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture) 

Job Summary

At Accenture Song, delivering top-notch solutions means ensuring development outcomes align with expectations. While manual testing is still important, there's an increasing focus on automating various testing types - functional, regression, visual, performance, and compatibility. As a Senior Technical Test Engineer, you'll take a leading role in our test automation initiatives, helping to drive quality across the board.

Roles And Responsibilities

Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for both UI and API testing.Create and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.Build, maintain, and enhance reusable automation frameworks using industry best practices.Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA team members to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve automation, environment, and test execution issues.Review automation scripts and test execution results to ensure adherence to automation standards and best practices.Leverage AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, and overall QA productivity.Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.Document defects, test execution results, and project status updates clearly and concisely.Drive continuous improvements in automation practices, testing processes, and overall software quality.Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.Demonstrate professionalism, ownership, and a proactive attitude towards delivering high-quality software.

jobs_results.description:
Job Summary
LymData Labs is looking for a QA / Test Engineer to take ownership of quality across our AI-powered software products and client projects.
This is a build-from-scratch QA role where you will define the testing strategy, establish release standards, build automation, perform API and web testing, and help us develop effective approaches for testing AI-powered features.


You will work across both the conventional web/API layer and the AI layer, including testing AI outputs, prompt changes, model upgrades, RAG systems, and edge cases.


Key ResponsibilitiesTest Strategy & Quality



Define and own the overall QA and testing strategy.
Decide what should be tested manually versus automated.
Define release gates and pre-release checklists.
Establish and maintain quality standards across client and in-house products.

Manual & Exploratory Testing

Create test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases from requirements, user stories, and designs.
Perform functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing.
Conduct exploratory and ad-hoc testing to identify issues beyond documented test cases.
Perform cross-browser testing across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge.
Perform cross-device testing across Android and iOS.
Validate UI and usability against designs.
Perform basic accessibility checks.
Maintain regression test suites and test documentation.
Manually review AI outputs and evaluate their quality.

Automation & API Testing

Build and maintain the automation framework from scratch.
Work with tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
Identify high-value test scenarios suitable for automation.
Perform API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent tools.
Integrate automated tests into CI pipelines so failures are identified early.

AI / LLM Testing

Build and maintain evaluation datasets for AI-powered features.
Test prompt changes and model version upgrades.
Perform regression testing when AI providers or models change.
Test retrieval quality and grounding in RAG-based systems.
Identify hallucinations, prompt injection vulnerabilities, unsafe outputs, and edge-case failures.
Test failure scenarios such as rate limits, timeouts, malformed model responses, token limits, and fallback behaviour.
Monitor AI output quality in production and identify quality drift.

Collaboration & Reporting

Own the bug lifecycle from discovery through verified resolution.
Provide clear reproduction steps and severity/priority assessments.
Participate in requirement discussions and identify ambiguity early.
Report on escaped defects, regression trends, and AI evaluation results.
Collaborate closely with developers and the engineering team.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in software testing / QA, with strong experience testing web applications.
Strong manual testing and exploratory testing skills.
Ability to create comprehensive test cases from requirements and designs.
Good understanding of:
Boundary Value Analysis
Equivalence Partitioning
Decision Tables
Defect Lifecycle
Severity vs. Priority
Risk-Based Testing
Experience with cross-browser and cross-device testing.
Experience with a test management tool such as TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Qase, or equivalent.
Hands-on experience with UI automation using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
Experience with API testing and understanding API documentation.
Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for writing test scripts.
Working knowledge of SQL.
Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira, Linear, or ClickUp.
Familiarity with Git.
Ability to write clear and actionable bug reports.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with the following will be an advantage:

Testing LLM or ML-powered applications.
AI evaluation tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas, LangSmith, or Langfuse.
Working directly with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models.
Understanding of RAG architecture, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, and grounding.
CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
Performance testing using JMeter or k6.
Setting up QA/testing infrastructure in a startup or small-team environment.
ISTQB Foundation certification.

AI testing experience is a bonus, not a requirement. We value strong QA fundamentals, scripting ability, curiosity, and the ability to reason about how AI systems should be tested.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who:

Can independently own QA and quality standards.
Thinks like a user, not just a test case executor.
Enjoys exploratory testing and finding unexpected issues.
Is comfortable testing systems where outputs may vary.
Can determine what "correct enough" means for AI-powered features.
Is confident enough to challenge a release when quality standards are not met.
Looks for opportunities to automate repetitive testing tasks.
Is curious about AI and enjoys finding ways to break systems before users do.

Why Join LymData Labs?

Real ownership: Build the QA process rather than inheriting an existing one.
Work on AI-powered products: Solve new and evolving testing challenges.
Direct impact: Work closely with a small engineering team with short feedback cycles.
Growth opportunity: Potential progression into a QA Lead role as the team grows.
Learning support: Learning budget available for certifications and courses.

Application Process
Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.
Email: info@lymdata.com


Phone: 9495834213
As part of the application, please include a short note describing one bug you are proud of finding and how you discovered it.
Screening Questions

How would you test a login flow you've never seen before? What would you check beyond the happy path?
Which automation frameworks have you personally set up from scratch?
How do you decide what to automate and what to keep manual?
Have you tested an AI/LLM-powered feature? If yes, how did you determine whether the output was acceptable?
What percentage of your previous role involved manual testing versus automation?
Which test management tools have you used?
Have you worked as the only QA person on a team? If yes, what was the most challenging part?
What are your current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period?

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month
Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala (Kochi)

jobs_results.description:
Introduction:

Welcome to Gallagher in India  where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services.  

More than just an operations center, its a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Associate Quality Engineering Lead who will act as a validation and quality assurance expert and review the functionality of existing systems. You will conduct requirement analysis, define test strategy & design and lead execution to guarantee superior outcomes.  

The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership across QA initiatives, work across the full product lifecycle, partnering closely with engineering, product, and design to define test strategies, build automated testing frameworks, and proactively identify issues before they reach production.

Self-motivated in handling multiple assignments across cross-functional teams.

How you'll make an impact

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy  

- Lead and mentor the QA team in defining and executing comprehensive QA strategies, test plans, and test cases.
- Drive adoption of automated testing tools and frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and reliability.
- Introduce and scale AI-driven QA capabilities, including intelligent test case generation, prioritization, and insights.
- Define and establish QA metrics and KPIs to measure testing effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
- Oversee defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk assessments across releases.
- Stay current with industry trends in test automation, AI-assisted testing, and quality engineering practices.

Planning & Execution Test  

- Review product requirements, specifications, and user stories; translate them into detailed test plans and comprehensive test suites.
- Define and execute test strategies for new and existing features, including:
- Functional testing
- End to End & Regression testing
- Security testing (wherever applicable)
- Exploratory and random testing
- Ensure full verification and validation of the software stack through both manual and automated testing
- Investigate and troubleshoot issues reported by customers or internal stakeholders, driving root cause resolution.

Automation & Tools  

- Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated test frameworks.
- Collaborate with development teams to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
- Ensure scalable and maintainable automation solutions aligned with product architecture.

Defect Management  

- Own defect submission, tracking, validation, and closure throughout the SDLC.
- Partner closely with engineering and product teams to ensure timely resolution of quality issues.
- Monitor defect trends and implement preventive quality improvements.

CrossFunctional Collaboration  

- Partner closely with product owners and software engineers to align quality standards and priorities.
- Participate in release planning and deployment activities, ensuring smooth and successful releases.
- Ensure QA alignment with business goals, user expectations, and technical requirements.

Technical Quality Engineering  

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, or Azure Dev Ops.
- Apply technical troubleshooting and risk-based testing approaches across complex systems.

Project & Delivery Support  

- Support Agile ceremonies and coordinate test planning, execution, and reporting.
- Collaborate with product owners and SMEs for requirement analysis and data mapping clarifications.
- Ensure timely QA deliverables aligned with sprint goals and release timelines.

About you:

Qualifications  

- Education
- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Experience
- 6+ years of overall experience in Software Quality Engineering
- Strong experience leading both manual and automated testing in Agile environments
- Experience supporting CI/CD-driven deployments
- Strong understanding of insurance domainpolicy, commissions, premiums, claims, billing etc.

Preferred:

Technical Skills  

- Strong experience testing complex, highly integrated enterprise systems, including cloud, distributed, and legacy platforms
- Hands on experience with automated and testing tools Selenium, AccelQ, Cypress, Postman-API, App Dynamics etc. or similar tools
- Understanding of prompt engineering principles applied to test generation and validation
- Familiarity with AI agent frameworks applied to .
